front.title: BGP Extensions of SR Policy for DiffServ

abstract.t: This document defines BGP extensions to associate a Differentiated Services (DiffServ) Per-Hop Behavior (PHB) with a Segment Routing (SR) Policy candidate path. It introduces a new sub-TLV carried in the BGP Tunnel Encapsulation Attribute that accompanies an SR Policy NLRI, thereby publishing the binding between an SR Policy candidate path and a PHB.
